environment: Mac isolated candidate dataset and synthetic engineering fixture; no Windows deployment

synthetic_fixture_check.interpretation: Only evaluator behavior was checked; these figures are not model quality estimates.

guards: v1 mixed-split engineering reports cannot support quality claims.
v2 rejects predictions for another split and modified manifest, cases, or prediction files.
The v2 abstention marker cannot also be a gold label; missing predictions count as abstentions.
Natural-distribution test and security cases produce separate reports.
Verified temporal and source blind holdout is required before a gold dataset can enable a quality claim.
limitations: The current random component split is unsuitable as a blind holdout and must be re-split in a new dataset version.
The code cannot independently verify reviewer identity or that a model never saw blind-test content.
No paid model was run and no NLP accuracy was measured.
Windows production remained off and was not changed.
